item.title: KATSEYE, Charli xcx, Madonna & More Highlights of This Week’s Billboard Charts
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update! Every Tuesday, the Billboard charts get a fresh new look, and we're here to break down the highlights. Let's dive in!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "This week, some big names are making waves on the charts, including Ella Langley, Morgan Wallen, Charli xcx, Madonna, and Tyla. But one artist that's really catching our attention is KATSEYE, with their debut top 10 hit on the Billboard Global 200 - 'Animal'!"
[Short clip of "Animal" by KATSEYE plays]
Host: "What's even more interesting is that none other than Ed Sheeran co-wrote this song. He discovered KATSEYE's music last year and reached out to collaborate. The result? 'Animal', which bounds in at number 10 with nearly 30 million streams and 3,000 sales worldwide in its first week."
[Short music transition]
Host: "KATSEYE's been on a roll lately, with five consecutive top 40 hits this year alone. 'Animal' marks their highest entrance to date, debuting at number 24 on the Billboard Hot 100. We can't wait to see what's next for this rising star!"
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for this week's music update. For more chart highlights and news, head to Billboard's Chart Beat hub and sign up for their weekly newsletter. New charts come out every Tuesday morning, so stay tuned for more music excitement!"
